title: TD Talk: Back to the chat list and opening a chat are faster
text: Tapping Back now shows a fresh chat list at once, and the chat you just read no longer keeps its unread number. Opening a chat no longer spins every time: TD Talk asks for a lighter chat list and opens a chat with its newest 60 messages first. On the test system, opening a chat dropped from about 900 ms to about 400 ms, and a long chat's data from 352 kB to 42 kB.
points: In the TD Social phone app the last chat list and your last 6 chats (60 messages each) are kept on the phone and shown at once, then replaced by the server's answer.
The phone app loads its tabs one after the other, the one on screen first (this needs app version 0.2.2).
